partnershipPlan: Two parent representatives from schools with low consent return review the permission form and the consent-return findings; school nurses review the card-check procedure.
socialListening: None; the district's public enquiry line log is read for questions about the campaign.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The form came home in a bag full of other papers, in a language I read slowly.
items.implication: Count forms by delivery route and translate reminders.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The students we miss are the ones who are not in school when we come.
items.implication: Record absence as a reason for missed doses.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We will help, but not with another form to chase.
items.implication: Keep in-school data collection to one visit.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I wanted to talk to someone before I signed, and there was nobody to ask.
items.implication: Offer a phone contact with the reminder.

summary: Four composite voices on forms, absence, school workload and trust.
